open_blockers.detail: Owner has NO ADMIN RIGHTS. Xcode 26.3 + iOS SDK 26.2 present, but /Library/Developer/PrivateFrameworks/{CoreDevice,CoreSimulator}.framework are absent and only an admin can install them. xcodebuild refuses to start without CoreSimulator even for a device-only unsigned build, so NO iOS build of any kind is possible. The paid Developer Program does NOT work around this — TestFlight still needs an .ipa, which needs xcodebuild. FIX: an admin runs `sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch` once; after that a FREE Apple ID / Personal Team suffices. Verified working without admin: Godot generates the full iOS Xcode project, device+sim xcframeworks, MoltenVK and PCK; stops only on missing app icons.
open_blockers.owner: user — needs someone with admin on this Mac

open_blockers.detail: A complete signed APK now builds: 123MB, sdkVersion 24, arm64-v8a only, containing a real 100MB libsim_godot.so (verified by size, not just presence). `adb devices` lists nothing. Owner must connect an Android phone with USB debugging on: Settings > About > tap Build number 7x, then Developer options > USB debugging. Then `~/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb install -r <apk>`.

sim_core_numeric_contract.note: Frozen. Changing any of this invalidates every recorded battle and the golden hash.
sim_core_numeric_contract.rounding: mul and div both round half toward positive infinity
sim_core_numeric_contract.overflow: panics in every profile, never truncates
sim_core_numeric_contract.hasher: FNV-1a 64, hand-written — never std DefaultHasher, which is not stable across platforms
